name: the makeshift bunker command post
about: The makeshift bunker at the foot of the hill, with its cramped briefing room and console rooms, from which the battle of chapters 29 and 30 is run. The book gives only the details listed below; the rest of the design is invented, and contributors are welcome to replace it.
